items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: I went up to Greenwood Lake, up in the section of the woods that Sugar Ray Robinson was training

ctx.x: When I first went in they told me after the operation by that doctor, "You will have 4 months of bed rest and 2 months of convalescence and then you can go on back, you know. And I went by that.

And I went up to Greenwood Lake, up in the section of the woods that Sugar Ray Robinson was training, up in the mountains, I carried and I had my wife up there; I bought 2 cars, with promissory notes from my agent; getting ready to go on the road with 3 months of bookings, and come back, but I still didn't feel right.

I went in to rehearsal one day, go back for my final examination, the next day, early, to go back for a second day of rehearsals, have given the itinerary out, and this man slapped me in my face and said, "You've got to have this operation over again."
